item.description: Ikarkles #8457 the Twice-Born of the House of Hyperenor fell (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Pagasae). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.title: On the field at the Field of Ares, Ktekrates #729 and Hypsos #260 saw each other across th
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares, Ktekrates #729 and Hypsos #260 saw each other across the spears. Their houses are guest-friends. They lowered their weapons, as Glaukos and Diomedes did, and 16 were spared.

item.description: Dormedes #4192 carved Lykkrates #8579's name into a rib-bone and gave it away. They walk together at dusk now.

item.description: Ersion #1727 the Twice-Born of the House of Pelorus fell (the stone in their midst (House of Chthonius)). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.

item.description: Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born holds office, and votes with the House of Chthonius this season, for reasons nobody can see. Dion #3430 knows the reasons.

item.description: Ostologia for Thrasdoto Ersonides ~1310: ash raked, bones gathered, oar set upright. Elpenor asked for no more.

item.description: Kallphon #4830 and Theides #6957 fell in love in the Reef. The Gorgonides pretend not to notice.

item.title: Melmenes Polonides ~185 spoke to Lysmachos #5252 late into the night; by morning Lysmachos
item.description: Melmenes Polonides ~185 spoke to Lysmachos #5252 late into the night; by morning Lysmachos #5252 belonged to the Theriodai.

item.title: The god answered Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born in verse: "Lean jars in the Burning Lake of
item.description: The god answered Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born in verse: "Lean jars in the Burning Lake of Eridanus before the swallow comes." Nobody agrees what it means. Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born says they know.

item.title: Antimnikos #1949 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to
item.description: Antimnikos #1949 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: A child for the House of Udaeus: Thrasdoto Ersonides ~1310, born to Erson #4414 and Hermme
item.description: A child for the House of Udaeus: Thrasdoto Ersonides ~1310, born to Erson #4414 and Hermmenes #9328 the Blood-handed. It will grow old; its parents will not.

item.description: Melphon #4307 the Twice-Born's bones re-knit in the Asphodel Meadow and walked back to the Field of Ares. Only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Thrasias #9581 came out of the Daedalian fit holding the bronze sail of Thrasias, no hand
item.description: Thrasias #9581 came out of the Daedalian fit holding the bronze sail of Thrasias, no hand can lift twice. Nobody can say how it was made.

item.title: Thrasias #9581 now carries the bronze sail of Thrasias, no hand can lift twice.
item.description: Thrasias #9581 now carries the bronze sail of Thrasias, no hand can lift twice.

item.title: The god answered Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born in verse: "If the Burning Lake of Eridanus m
item.description: The god answered Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born in verse: "If the Burning Lake of Eridanus marches, a great city will fall." Nobody agrees what it means. Lysides #9283 the Twice-Born says they know.

item.title: Thrasias #9581 has been seized by the Daedalian fit. They will not eat; they demand bronze
item.description: Thrasias #9581 has been seized by the Daedalian fit. They will not eat; they demand bronze, and they draw shapes in the ash.

item.title: Thrasias #9581 took the staff in the Boule for the Gorgonides: "Hear me! Remember the ston
item.description: Thrasias #9581 took the staff in the Boule for the Gorgonides: "Hear me! Remember the stone in Lemnos. I say: let the temples get their tithe. As the old poet says, the gods hide a man's living from him." The assembly roared like the long waves of the Icarian sea.
